messages:
Rae: Quick heads-up 1 min sync: were running a focused copy microtest for Hosted / Dedicated / Private hero messaging next week. Aim: improve signups and webinar signups while capturing clearer lead intent. who can help build variants?
Tom: I can help. thinking we do 3 hero themes: Time-to-value, Cost & Efficiency, Security/Compliance. run each across the three product pages.
Priya: good. measurement objective: improve qualified leads (score >= 30) and webinar opt-ins. Also track % routed to AE vs self-serve.
Ken: product details: Dedicated should call out "reserved GPU pools" and a short SLAs line. Private needs KMS + on-prem note. Hosted should lean on "quick start" and curated models.
Nora: proposed short hero lines (one-liners):
- Hosted: "Ship features fast with a managed inference API"
- Dedicated: "Predictable throughput with reserved GPU capacity"
- Private: "Deploy inference inside your network with KMS control"
Add 1-sentence subheads that mention pricing model / SLA / compliance.
Rae: Love the direction. For variety, Tom can also draft variants with different tone (developer-focused vs product-focused).
Tom: Doing that. Also propose a subtle webinar banner in hero: "Live: Serving LLMs at scale a June 2 a" different CTA = "Save my seat" (separate list).
Priya: Routing plan (HubSpot lists):
```
- hosted -> list: landing_hosted_trial; lead_source=copy_microtest_499999
- dedicated -> list: landing_dedicated_inquiry; lead_source=copy_microtest_499999
- private -> list: landing_private_sales; lead_source=copy_microtest_499999
- webinar -> list: webinar_signups_copytest; lead_source=copy_microtest_499999_hero
```
Ken: For Dedicated form, add quick qual fields: desired qps, preferred region, estimated monthly token volume. Then map to AE SDR queue if > X.
Nora: Copy variants checklist for each hero: headline (max 8 words), subhead (one sentence), CTA (primary), CTA microcopy (privacy/trial), 1 feature micro-bullet (under hero), small webinar banner copy. Keep language plain.
Rae: experiment setup: 3 hero themes x 3 pages x 2 tones = 18 variants. Run for 7 days, aim for 2k impressions per variant if feasible. Tom, can you coordinate with Growth to set weights?
Tom: will do. default: even split for first 72 hrs, then reweight by CTR. UA tags: utm_campaign=copy_microtest_jun2026, utm_content=hero_variant_{id}.
Priya: KPI dashboard: impressions, CTR, form submit rate, qualified lead rate, webinar conversion. Also capture sample of open-ended feedback from chat widget for qualitative signals.
Tracking Bot: Ive created placeholder tracking links: https://rwd.test/track/X1Y2 (hosted), https://rwd.test/track/X3Y4 (dedicated), https://rwd.test/track/X5Z6 (private), webinar: https://rwd.test/track/WB99. Will verify when pages are staged.
Ken: small ask: avoid vague claims like "industry-leading". Prefer explicit, testable claims (SLA percentiles, latency ranges for common seq lengths).
Nora: I'll draft the 18 variants and post them as short items here by Tue 16:00 PT. Rae, do we want to include a short feature callout under Dedicated for "autoscaling pools"?
Rae: yes, but keep it one short phrase. Also include 1 line of microcopy about data retention & privacy under each CTA.
Tom: can someone pull baseline metrics for existing landing CTAs? need to compare lift.
Priya: I have the baseline. posting now: Hosted CTR 3.1%, Dedicated CTR 1.2%, Private CTR 0.8%, webinar banner CTR 0.9%.
Rae: thanks. owners: Nora (copy), Priya (tracking & dashboard), Tom (experiment setup), Ken (accuracy review). We meet Thu 09:00 PT to finalize.
Nora: posting first pass in thread in 30m.
Tracking Bot: Staging hooks created. Webhooks for form routing will be tested Wed 14:00 PT.
Rae: Great work team. keep copy tight and testable. low hype, high clarity. :white_check_mark:
